title: Homology comparison square for decalage and the Grothendieck spectral object
statement: Let F,G be additive left exact functors satisfying injective acyclicity [def-sp-composite-acyclicity], with P a presentation [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation], its second filtration L, and prescribed common augmentation a. For q>=0 and n>=0 there exist isomorphisms from H^n(Tot(GI)) and H^n(Dec(L)^(-q)) [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage] to the full and truncated values of the canonical Grothendieck spectral object. They intertwine the decalage inclusion and the spectral-object map from bottom->q+1 to bottom->top. The full isomorphism is normalized by the augmentation and P.J.isoRightDerivedObj.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology

proof.text: Use the compatible bounded-below injective full and cut models. Their right-derived-functor unit maps are isomorphisms. Compare them using naturality of the unit and the localization-homology isomorphisms, and apply RG to the derived truncation square. The explicit spectral-object formula identifies its map with RG of the truncation inclusion.

Compose the full total isomorphism, the derived unit, inverse localization of b, and the canonical resolution-derived comparison to obtain e. Define d similarly using r and truncation of the resolution comparison. The normalized resolution-unit comparison identifies the composite with the original augmentation computation; cancel the invertible localization of b to prove the required normalization.
